name: Please Be Quiet Lexington 2022
information:
This is a quiet events competition. We will NOT be holding usual events like 3x3. If you are a new competitor or looking for more normal events, this probably isn't for you, and you may want to check out other competitions, such as Empire State Winter [A](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/EmpireStateWinterA2022) and [B](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/EmpireStateWinterB2022).

Please make sure to review the COVID Safety tab. If COVID cases rise, we may need to cancel this competition; competitors will be notified by email in that case.
